data.summary: Contains validation and acceptance testing scripts for data pipeline stages, specifically testing idempotent MERGE and watermarking.

file_insights.name: check_stage3.py
file_insights.summary: Tests stage 3 data pipeline acceptance criteria such as idempotent MERGE and watermark handling.
file_insights.source_summary: Implements script to test stage 3 acceptance criteria by running load operations with and without watermarks and asserting correct table row counts.
file_insights.detailed_description: Performs acceptance tests for Stage 3 data pipeline features, including idempotent MERGE, watermark handling on updated_at timestamps, deduplication, and verifying that dirty records survive into the ODS layer. It runs the load pipeline with multiple iterations and checks state counts.
responsibilities: Test idempotent MERGE operations in data loading
Validate watermark behavior on updated_at fields
Check deduplication logic and dirty record persistence in ODS
